turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Hi, this is Sam calling from Maple Bank. This call may be recorded for quality and training purposes.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: May I with Theodore Pascual?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Speaking.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Before we continue, can you please confirm your date of birth?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Sure, it's [PII].

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thank you. I'm calling about your account with Maple Bank, which is past due.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Let me just pull up your account. moment please.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Okay.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thanks for waiting, I have it here.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: The amount past due today is $803.70.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: I'm not able to pay that right now. My disability claim has been pending since Jun.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Stop calling me every day! This is harassment.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I'm sorry to hear that. We have hardship options, like a reduced payment for three months. Would you like me to review that with you?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Yes, that would help.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: To set that I'll need a quick look at your monthly budget. What are your main fixed expenses?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Mostly rent, groceries and the car.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Okay, I've noted that. The hardship will follow up with the details.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: I can pay $405 Friday.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Just to confirm, a payment of $405.00 on September 25. I'll send you a payment link.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Before I transfer you, we can also set up a payment plan.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Do you have any other for me?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: No, I think that's it.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thank you for your time today. You'll receive a confirmation by text. Have a good evening.
